messages.subject: APK source closure/frontend/Rust passed; calibrating own notebook RSS cap for Gradle
messages.body: Actual ebde+overlay APK frontend and first nativeRust link passed; Gradle8.14.3 reached Kotlin/package tasks, then own runner4GiBsummed-RSS cap stopped its processgroup at04:06:12 with4.779GBsummedRSS while MemAvailable18.185GB/disk83.778GB. This is preserved runnerresource-cap outcome, not observedOOM/temperature admission; that4GiBcap was kit-defined rather than an explicit Root notebookbudget. Retrying same isolatedsource/cached artifacts with max8GiBowned-treeRSS plus >=8GiBMemAvailable,2CPUaffinity/2jobs/1200s, generated task-only Gradle2workers/2GiBheap/inprocessKotlin and exact scoped daemon reconciliation; no sharedRootresource/SUT, source/model/runtime substitution, or900START.
